survivorship_bias: Walk-forward evidence now spans up to ~30 years of history (1996 to present, each name from its real first bar), but it is measured over a candidate pool built from CURRENT index members and therefore carries survivorship bias: names that were delisted or dropped along the way are absent from the whole span, so realized forward returns may be overstated. Read the edge as an upper bound, not a guarantee.
descriptive_caveat: Descriptive evidence, not a predictive model: these are realized forward returns sorted by a stored factor on the current-membership (universe-relative) seed — read them as historical association, never a forecast. Low-sample deciles show NA + n rather than a fabricated number.
